description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for a configuration GUI application, including classes for configuration list, items, main window, and related components.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: Handles application settings, including reading and writing size configurations.

classes.name: ConfigList
classes.description: A widget representing a list of configuration items, supporting various modes and interactions.

classes.name: ConfigItem
classes.description: Represents an individual configuration item within the list, with icons and hierarchical relationships.

classes.name: ConfigItemDelegate
classes.description: Custom delegate for editing configuration items within views.

classes.name: ConfigInfoView
classes.description: Displays detailed information about selected configuration elements, with debug options.

classes.name: ConfigSearchWindow
classes.description: Dialog window for searching within configuration items.

classes.name: ConfigMainWindow
classes.description: Main application window managing configuration display, editing, and navigation.

methods.name: findConfigItem
methods.description: Finds a configuration item based on menu structure.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets selection state for a list item.

methods.name: setRootMenu
methods.description: Sets the root menu for the list.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a configuration item.

methods.name: changeValue
methods.description: Changes the value of a configuration item.
